main_claim: Adding a matched cognitive prior via leakage-safe late fusion improves both Working Memory and Fluid Intelligence prediction relative to architecture-matched no-prior baselines, and the prior-aware FC branch demonstrates task-prior alignment with specificity against negative controls.
main_prediction_caveat: Conservative repeated-CV dependence correction yields nonsignificant p-values (WM 0.51, Fluid 0.52). Seed-level Wilcoxon and bootstrap CI support positive effect. Fluid Intelligence mean delta +0.0079 does not meet predefined large-margin gate (+0.010); described as consistent positive improvement.
main_biomarker_caveat: FP branch is regularized toward the prior by design, so high matched-task alignment is expected. The informative comparison is specificity against unrelated/shuffled/random controls, which the matched prior dominates 10/10 seeds for both tasks.
